GOING LIVE IS TWO THINGS, AND THE ORDER MATTERS.
mccain-digital.com does NOT point at Vercel (measured 11.9.2026: nginx,
SiteGround, the English v2 site from June, indexable). So going live means
moving the domain AND turning this off - and the domain must move LAST:
pointing an indexed domain at a noindex site asks Google to remove it.
2. remove the X-Robots-Tag line from vercel.json
3. rebuild, then node tools/verify_site.mjs  (it fails if 1 and 2 disagree)
4. add mccain-digital.com to the Vercel project, then move the DNS
5. node tools/domain_check.mjs  - it passes only once the domain serves
